== Summary ==
'''CardMaker recreation''' of [[Bane Malar, Spice Addict (Errata 2)]], showing the '''PC-E2''' game text (the PC website card list). '''Re-rendered in CardMaker: no published image of this text.''' The release-sheet slip ([[:File:VB8-02-Bane_Malar_Spice_Addict.png]]) and the Master List (2013) show the words of [[Bane Malar, Spice Addict]] and the current text.

* '''Text source:''' Players Committee website card list (VBlock8Type), as captured 21 July 2012 (https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064747/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock8Type.html); 12 December 2012 (https://web.archive.org/web/20121212003733/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock8Type.html); 11 January 2013 (https://web.archive.org/web/20130111142925/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock8Type.html); also on the Virtual master list (VMasterType) to 11 January 2013. Typos, capitals and punctuation are kept as published; icons the list writes out in words, and its straight quote marks, are drawn as the printed slip draws them.
* '''PC-E2 text:''' “Adds 2 to the power of anything he pilots. Once per turn, may 'mindscan' by placing a card from hand on your Used Pile; choose: until end of turn Malar is power +2 and may fire a weapon twice per battle. OR peek at the top X cards of your Force pile where X = number of characters here.”
* '''Made:''' 11 November 2026 with the SWCCG CardMaker (https://swccg.com/cardmaker/, repo billbisco/swccg-cardmaker, STANDARD rev 74) from the card's own Virtual Legacy card (Decipher art, frame, title, lore, icons, set mark, slip label and copyright line as printed) with the PC-E2 game text. Holotable size, 745 × 1039. Rebuild spec: <code>.spec.json</code> next to the image in the batch C2/C3 run folder.
* '''Not an official image.''' Card art and design © Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc.; virtual card text by the Star Wars CCG Players Committee.
